coastal.title: New trial ordered for Vancouver man convicted of 2nd-degree murder
coastal.description: A Vancouver man who was convicted of second-degree murder after a fatal stabbing of a fellow resident of a psychiatric facility will face a new trial.

kamloops.title: Ahead of municipal election, Kelowna mayor asks feds to shut down supervised consumption site
kamloops.description: The mayor of Kelowna, B.C., has written to the federal health minister asking for authorities to deny the renewal of a supervised consumption site operating in the city's downtown core. Mayor Tom Dyas's letter comes a little under two months before the municipal election in the city, in which he is running for re-election.

kamloops.title: Uber drivers in B.C.'s Interior join Vancouver Island in unionization agreement
kamloops.description: The United Food and Commercial Workers union says Uber drivers in the Okanagan-Kootenay-Cariboo areas are joining UFCW 1518, and will be covered by an agreement first negotiated by drivers in Victoria.

prince-george.title: Missing person found dead in Fraser River was killed, Prince George RCMP believe
prince-george.description: 29-year-old Julian Wich was reported missing Jan. 2 and found dead six months later

all.title: K'ómoks and We Wai Kai First Nations sign protocol agreement
all.description: The K'ómoks and We Wai Kai First Nations on mid-Vancouver Island say they have signed a historic protocol agreement as neighbouring nations.
